title: Overlapping renewal runs leave invoice status inconsistent
summary: Renewal batches report some accounts as unbilled while invoice retries remain noisy.
precursor: A delayed scheduler run overlapped with the regional catch-up job after a short queue pause.
impact: Monthly charges are delayed for affected accounts, and support agents see conflicting invoice status across retries.

title: Plan upgrades stall during checkout
summary: Plan upgrades remain pending during checkout, with intermittent gateway warnings.
precursor: A tax calculation service began responding more slowly in one region shortly after a plan catalog rollout.
impact: Customers abandon some upgrades and successful requests take long enough to trigger duplicate support inquiries.

title: Subscription change stream stops advancing
summary: Subscription-change processing is no longer advancing for a small group of accounts.
precursor: A legacy annual-to-monthly change produced an event containing an uncommon proration adjustment during a migration window.
impact: Proration updates and resulting invoices are delayed until the affected event sequence is recovered.

title: Settlement exports accumulate after maintenance
summary: Settlement exports are accumulating and the payment integration shows repeated authorization failures.
precursor: Gateway credentials were renewed during scheduled maintenance while the exporter deployment was rolling across two worker pools.
impact: Daily settlement files arrive late, delaying finance reconciliation and payment exception review.

title: Refund adjustments fail on imported accounts
summary: Refund adjustments for a subset of migrated accounts fail validation and remain open in the operator queue.
precursor: A customer-account merge imported historical refund requests before all related invoice records were available in the ledger.
impact: Affected refunds cannot be finalized, leaving customer balances unresolved and finance reconciliation incomplete.
